entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I assist you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-881-92B.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF-881-92B. I see an order here for the Apex Pro cycling shoes, delivered on January 6th. Is that correct?
Yes. I need to start the return process.
I can certainly look into that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't fit right. They gave me awful blisters after one ride. I tried adjusting the cleats, but it's a lost cause. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that caused you blisters. Let me just confirm the policy for you. Okay, I see the delivery was 17 days ago.
So, yes or no? Can I return them?
Yes, absolutely. Our policy allows for returns on items like these cycling shoes for up to 90 days. You are well within that window.
Good. So what's the next step?

I've just approved the return in our system. I am sending an email to you now with a prepaid return label. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Got the email. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
